description: Add an always-visible fuel reserve forecast that tells miners whether their current fuel can cover a safe return from the present depth before they commit to a deeper drill or route.
steps: Use and consult miner-daily-task-runner before implementing; run ./init.sh before development, preserve the React-before-runtime startup order, and retain the existing DOM IDs/classes consumed by src/dom.ts and src/game.ts.

Inspect src/game.ts movement, drilling, hover fuel drain, surface servicing, reset/game-over paths, src/balance.ts fuel constants, src/objective.ts, src/ui.tsx HUD hooks, src/dom.ts, src/styles.css, and existing Vitest coverage to define a small DOM-free fuel-reserve formatter/classifier based on real player depth, fuel, route assumptions, and balance values rather than duplicated magic numbers.

Add one stable HUD hook near the objective and terrain scanner that gives concise actionable return guidance such as a safe return reserve, a caution threshold, or an urgent turn-back warning, including a transparent conservative assumption when an exact tunnel route cannot be known. Recompute it after movement, drilling, load, reset, game-over, fuel upgrades/refuels, and surface return without exposing stale state.

Keep the new readout readable at desktop and phone sizes, avoid crowding or leaking through the Info / Cargo modal, and preserve existing scanner, objective, cargo-value, service guidance, keyboard, and touch behavior.

Add DOM-free unit tests for safe/caution/urgent reserve decisions and formatting plus React/runtime-hook coverage; run ./init.sh and live desktop and 390×844 CDP smokes that start the game, mine into the starter seam, observe the forecast change with depth/fuel, return to the depot or reset, open/close Info / Cargo, move again, and collect runtime exceptions.
acceptance: Before committing to deeper mining, players can see an always-visible concise fuel reserve forecast derived from real game fuel/balance state that clearly distinguishes a safe return, caution, and an urgent turn-back condition.

The forecast updates after movement, drilling, refueling/tank upgrades, surface return, load, reset, and game-over paths; it remains honest about route assumptions and does not regress the existing HUD guidance, Info / Cargo modal, keyboard/touch input, or responsive layout.
DOM-free reserve logic and React/runtime hook coverage pass, and live desktop/phone browser smokes confirm the readout reacts during gameplay with no runtime exceptions.
Before marking complete, follow miner-daily-task-runner and run ./init.sh, ./test.sh, npm test, npm run typecheck, and npm run build as fresh final verification.
